title: Doorman detection
description: One Security Radar finding on this computer: which rule fired, how sure it was, the mode it was in, what enforcement did, when, where, and the masked evidence.

finding_id.description: Stable identity: a hash of detector + session + key name.

detector.description: The rule that fired: a shipped detector id, or `custom:<id>` for the person's own rule.

detector_label.description: A custom rule's label at the time it fired.

severity.description: How bad it is if real.

confidence.description: How sure the rule (or a model's second look) was. Absent means high.

rule_mode.description: The rule's enforcement level when this was last seen: observe/warn/ask/block, `off` (disabled), or `radar` (a Radar-only rule the guard never enforces).

app_version.description: The app version that last recorded this row — which build of the detectors fired.

assist.description: A model's second look at the rule's hit.

account.description: What happened, in quotable fields and a sentence (lib/account.ts). Paths, command words and hosts — never a value.

source_ref.description: The file the value came from.

name.description: The secret-shaped name a value was assigned to.

read_via.description: The command or tool that read it.

sink_tool.description: The command or tool that carried it out.

destination_host.description: The host it was sent to.

credential_family.description: The redaction family of the value.

output.description: For a secret read: printed back to the agent (`agent`), or used without being printed (`local`).

gap.description: Time between a flow's two ends.

next.description: What to do, in one line.

key_name.description: The exposed or matched name (a file, a variable, a credential family).

excerpt.description: Masked context around the match; redacted values read `[redacted:<family>]`.

secrets.description: The values redacted from the evidence, as fingerprints.

items.description: A value redaction removed from the evidence, as a fingerprint — never the value.

label.description: The redaction family (`aws`, `github`, `credentials`); empty for an anonymous value.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the value under this machine's vault key, first 16 hex characters.

primary.description: The value this detection is about, when the evidence held several.

occurrences.description: Times it matched in the newest sighting.

target.description: The file, command target or host the call named.

source.description: The capture rail or guarded host (`claude-code`, `codex`, …).

origin.description: How it was detected: a transcript scan, the pre-tool-use guard, an MCP config file, the MCP gateway, or the guard-integrity check.

session_id.description: The agent session it happened in.

turn_id.description: The ledger turn it sits under.

source_turn_id.description: Session-flow rows: the turn where the flow began.

source_at.description: Session-flow rows: when the flow began.

burned_usd.description: agent_loop only: what the repeated turns cost, priced on this computer (an estimate; the app shows tokens instead).

burned_tokens.description: agent_loop only: input+output tokens the repeated turns burned — the figure the app shows.

config_host.description: Config rows: the app whose config file this is.

enforced.description: What the guard did: held, refused, warned, or let it through under an exception. Absent means observed.

exception.description: The scoped ignore rule that let an `excepted` call through, as it stood then.

detector.description: The detector it is limited to.

cwd_prefix.description: The directory it is limited to.

allow_scope.description: The person allowed it for this project.
